messages.subject: Whitcombe - draft settlement agreement
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Ms Bartlett,

Further to the agreement in principle, please find attached the draft settlement agreement in redline against our earlier draft, reflecting the agreed figures (£30,000 tax-free / £78,000 taxable, £15,000 costs, 21-day payment) and the agreed reference at Schedule 3. We've shown our changes as tracked so you can see what's moved since the last exchange.

Grateful for any comments. We'd hope to have this signed next week, with the claim withdrawn on receipt of the signed agreement and your certificate.

Best wishes,
Tom Gallagher
Associate | Employment
Whitfield Carter LLP
T +44 (0)20 7946 0538

Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: Whitcombe - draft settlement agreement
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Mr Gallagher,

Thank you. The draft is acceptable subject to two small points: (i) please confirm the £15,000 costs contribution is paid directly to this firm against our invoice; and (ii) please add a 10-working-day turnaround on the reference, which I see you have already done. Otherwise we are content and will arrange for our client to attend to sign and for me to give the statutory advice this week. Eleanor Bartlett, Ashworth Quinn LLP
